key_insight: Stochastic transport connects uncertainty modelling in geophysical flows with rigorous analysis, data-driven calibration and high-dimensional Bayesian inference.
engineering_relevance: This framework supports uncertainty-aware forecasting and data assimilation for ocean and other geophysical fluid systems.
method: Establish well-posedness, regularity and approximation theory using stochastic variational principles and rough paths.
Calibrate stochastic transport structures from observations and high-resolution simulations.
Develop Bayesian data assimilation through particle filters and machine-learning uncertainty quantification.
evidence_signal: The abstract reviews theoretical and methodological developments and identifies observational and simulation data as calibration sources, but reports no quantitative evaluation results.
watch_item: Computational scalability and forecast accuracy in high-dimensional applications require validation beyond the evidence provided in the abstract.
paper_title: From Stochastic Transport Models to High-Dimensional Bayesian Inference
